title: Test authenticated preparation shape
objective: Measure preparation loop traffic for the five largest authenticated buffers and retain only a general authenticated-logical-shape compiler correction that improves the phase by at least 10% with identical fused H1 evidence

oracles: authenticated fused H1 hashes, counters, RNG, root, and p192 getfu

runs.command: bounded instrumented addon build and exact baseline profile
runs.result: passed; 323.165s build, 2390424 KiB peak, frozen evidence exact
passed; preparation improved 20.91%, frozen evidence exact

runs.command: bounded noncanonical no-clear diagnostic build and exact profile
runs.result: passed; 315.816s build, 2390268 KiB peak, preparation improved 91.43%, frozen evidence exact
passed; closed graph authority and all required revocations

handoff.summary: Confirmed capacity-scaled spare-limb clearing dominates H1 preparation: 582 logical writes trigger 4,866,048 cleared words. Diagnostic controls improve preparation by 20.91% with right-sizing and 91.43% without private spare clearing, with all frozen evidence exact. The unsafe global setter change was reverted. Added fail-closed structural authority for a future private noncanonical buffer region; it emits no behavior change.
risks: Global no-clear violates the public canonical IntegerBuffer ABI and must not be restored.
Results are single diagnostic profiles, not seven-pair qualification timings.
next_steps: Implement a separately reviewed private noncanonical IntegerBuffer proof with mandatory canonicalization at every escape boundary.
Poison spare limbs and compare full raw buffers across GMP, FLINT, JavaScript, and Wasm before using the mode in H1.
